fields.name: Jagadīśa dāsa Bābājī (Kāliya-daha)
fields.aka: Jagadīśa Dāsa Bābājī Mahāśaya, Jagadīśa Bābā of Kāliya-daha
fields.disappearance: 1322 BS (1915 AD), at Kāliya-daha, Vṛndāvana, aged a hundred (the record's text)
fields.place: Kālnā (a physician there); Vṛndāvana: near the old Madana-mohana temple, then a kuṭīra at Kāliya-daha
fields.guru: Siddha Bhagavān dāsa Bābājī of Kālnā
fields.notes: Of a high brāhmaṇa family; a physician at Kālnā before taking dīkṣā from Siddha Bhagavān dāsa Bābājī, who gave him his guru-praṇālī. Lived on mādhukarī in Vṛndāvana, without salt; visited Nityānanda's gaddī at Śṛṅgāra-vaṭa daily (Premānanda Gosvāmī). Taught tṛṇād api sunīcena above all. Died at Kāliya-daha in 1322 BS (1915), a hundred years old.

name: Govinda dāsa Bābājī (Haridāsa Ṭhākura Maṭha, Purī)

fields.disciples: Giridhārī dāsa Bābājī of the Haribol Kuṭīra (veśa)

fields.name: Dharma dāsa Bābājī (Kāmyavana)
fields.disappearance: About 1889 or 1890, nearly a hundred years old (the record's text)
fields.place: Born in Orissa; Kāmyavana (Vimalā-kuṇḍa, the temple of Śrī Rādhā-Madanagopāla)
fields.guru: Of the line of Siddha Jayakṛṣṇa dāsa Bābājī of Kāmyavana (his grand-disciple)
fields.notes: An Oriyā of little learning, the grand-disciple of Siddha Bābā of Kāmyavana, whose Deity Śrī Rādhā-Madanagopāla he served at Vimalā-kuṇḍa; never criticised anyone; served the Vrajavāsīs and visiting Vaiṣṇavas. Died about 1889–1890, nearly a hundred.

fields.place: Born at Mādhavapura (Nadia); Simuliyā (the ākhaḍā); Navadvīpa; Vṛndāvana; Kusuma-sarovara; Govinda-kuṇḍa (from 1893; his temple of Śrī Madana-mohana, 1917)

fields.name: Jagadānanda dāsa Bābājī (Rādhākuṇḍa)
fields.aka: Jagadānanda Dāsa Bābājī Mahāśaya, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita (Bābājī)
fields.place: Born probably in the Faridpur district; Sūrya-kuṇḍa; Rādhākuṇḍa (beside the samāja of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī)
fields.guru: Bhagavān dāsa Bābājī, mahānta of an ākhaḍā at Samādiā, Faridpur (bheka, at 18 or 19)
fields.disciples: Advaita dāsa Paṇḍita (his student in śāstra)
fields.notes: Probably of a brāhmaṇa family of Faridpur; took bheka at 18 or 19 from Bhagavān dāsa Bābājī of Samādiā; a paṇḍita without equal among the Vaiṣṇavas of his time, close to Siddha Jayakṛṣṇa of Kāmyavana, Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa of Govardhana and Siddha Madhusūdana of Sūrya-kuṇḍa. His student Advaita dāsa Paṇḍita (Hari-nāmāmṛta grammar, Garāṇhāṭī kīrtana) told his life.

fields.appearance: 22 Caitra; the text says 1896, but it does not agree with its other dates
fields.place: Born at Konarpur (Faridpur); Vṛndāvana; Navadvīpa; Barāhanagara Pāṭabāḍī
fields.guru: Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa Deva (Gaura-mantra, at Cuttack); in his boyhood the companion of Prabhu Jagadbandhu
fields.works: Carita-sudhā (the life of Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa, six volumes)
fields.notes: Born Rādhikācaraṇa, eighth son of Durgācaraṇa Gupta and Satyabhāmā of Konarpur. As a boy the chief helper of Prabhu Jagadbandhu (who called him Sārikā); initiated by Rādhāramaṇa-caraṇa dāsa Deva at Cuttack, he led the community after him: saved Haridāsa Ṭhākura's samādhi-temple at Purī from auction, founded a home for the sick and old at Navadvīpa, held the Pānihāṭi festival yearly, founded the library of the Barāhanagara Pāṭabāḍī. The years in his text are partly misprinted.

fields.name: Gaura dāsa Bābājī (Nandagrāma)
fields.place: Nandagrāma: Sanātana Gosvāmī's bhajana-kuṭīra by Pāvana-sarovara (about 1873)
fields.notes: Did bhajana about 1873 in Sanātana Gosvāmī's bhajana-kuṭīra at Nandagrāma and offered flowers daily to Lālajī; when he set out for Varṣāṇā, Kṛṣṇa as a cowherd boy stopped him: «Who will offer Me flowers?» (Sudhanya Mitra, in GVJ). His guru is not given: the tree line to Sanātana Gosvāmī is marked as disputed (07-11-2026).

fields.disappearance: Jyaiṣṭha śukla caturdaśī, 1305 BS (1898) (the record's text)
fields.place: Vṛndāvana (the Śrīpāṭa of Nityānanda Prabhu he founded); Śrīpāṭa Puruliyā
fields.notes: Fourth-generation descendant of Nandakiśora; founded the Śrīpāṭa of Nityānanda Prabhu in Vṛndāvana. A great kīrtanīyā (taught by Golokadāsa Bābājī) and scholar, friend of Siddha Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī; earned more than two lakh rupees and kept nothing. Died on Jyaiṣṭha śukla caturdaśī 1305 BS (GBJ pp. 187-189). The tree line to Siddha Kṛṣṇadāsa of Govardhana has no source in his text (marked as disputed, 07-11-2026).

fields.place: Śrīkhaṇḍa; Navadvīpa (Siddha Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī's Bhajana-kuṭīra)
fields.notes: Of Śrīkhaṇḍa; in the 19th century he lived at Siddha Jagannātha dāsa Bābājī's Bhajana-kuṭīra in Navadvīpa, where, at Jagannātha dāsa's request, he initiated Ramahari dāsa Bābājī (record of Ramahari dāsa, #1860). He stood in the tree as a disciple of Mahāprabhu, without a source; that line is marked as disputed (07-11-2026).
